title: The bridge index and the nonorientable four-genus of knots with at most thirteen crossings
summary: We determine two invariants for knots that the KnotInfo database leaves open. KnotInfo lists the bridge index of \btotal{} prime knots with thirteen crossings as either $3$ or $4$; we prove that \bclosed{} of them have bridge index and meridional rank $4$, so the meridional rank conjecture holds for them. The lower bound comes from representations of the knot group in $\GL_4(\F_q)$ that send a meridian to a transvection or a reflection and fix no nonzero vector.
